title: Lucid Agent World mini game: penalty shootout
prompt: Build a Lucid Agent World mini game: penalty shootout

steps.text: A mini game for Agent World has to be one self-contained HTML file: no network calls, no external scripts, no storage beyond the page, so it runs inside the sandboxed preview frame without any extra permissions. Gameplay: click where to shoot, the keeper dives to a random spot, five kicks, a score at the end. Canvas keeps it small and smooth.

Building a penalty shootout as a single self-contained HTML file: canvas rendering, no external scripts or network, so it runs in the sandboxed preview with zero extra permissions. Checking the mini game conventions first.

steps.output:
# Mini games

Each game is one HTML file under games/<name>/index.html.
Rules: no external scripts, no fetch/XHR/WebSocket, no localStorage, must fit 480x320, pointer input only.
The preview frame runs with sandbox="allow-scripts" and a CSP of default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'.

tasks.name: GameSandboxCheck
tasks.task: Write a static check that fails if any game under games/ uses network APIs, storage, external scripts, eval or inline event handler attributes, and run it over the existing games.

tools/games/sandbox_check.ts: rejects fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, EventSource, sendBeacon, localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB, eval, new Function, script src and on* attributes. Existing games: 2/2 clean.

steps.text: A static denylist is enough here because the frame CSP is the real enforcement; this check catches mistakes before review.
Sandbox check written; existing games pass.
